wire.headline: Energy firm cuts jobs and closes plants as profits fall
sentences: Revenue for the quarter to 30 September rose 7% year over year to 4.26bn GBP.
The company announced 850 job cuts, representing about 6% of its workforce.
Two gas plants, one in Wales and one in Kent, will close by March 2027.
CEO Marian Holt stated that cost pressure was sharper than expected.
Ofgem opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend was held at 12.4p a share.
